description: This file defines an interface ICommonDirectoryGrain within the namespace UnitTests.GrainInterfaces.Directories. The interface extends IGrainWithGuidKey and declares methods for pinging, resetting, retrieving runtime ID, and proxy ping operation.

classes.name: ICommonDirectoryGrain
classes.description: An interface representing grain operations for directory management, including pinging, resetting, and retrieving runtime information.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Asynchronously pings the grain, returning an integer response.

methods.name: GetRuntimeInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the runtime instance ID of the grain asynchronously.

methods.name: ProxyPing
methods.description: Performs a proxy ping on another ICommonDirectoryGrain instance asynchronously.
